product: Service or product this run advertises
notes: One entry per concept. `template_number` is the sort key. Keep the visual-system preamble identical across every prompt — that shared prefix is what makes a set look like one campaign instead of N unrelated images.

prompts.intended_use: Top of funnel. One claim, no product shot.
prompts.prompt: <VISUAL SYSTEM PREAMBLE — identical in every prompt: ground colour, exactly one accent colour, mood adjectives, grain treatment, and an explicit 'no gradients, no additional colours'.> — A purely typographic advertisement on <ground colour>. Vertical 4:5 feed format. Layout, top to bottom: (1) a small all-caps eyebrow in <mono font>, letter-spacing 0.26em, in <accent colour>, reading exactly: '<EYEBROW>'. (2) A multi-line headline in <display font> at light weight, reading exactly: '<HEADLINE>', with '<KEY WORD>' set in italic <accent colour>. (3) A two-line supporting sentence in <body font>. (4) A solid <accent colour> button reading exactly '<CTA>'. (5) The wordmark bottom-left. Generous margins, large negative space.

prompts.intended_use: Retargeting. One number carries the whole frame.
prompts.prompt: <SAME VISUAL SYSTEM PREAMBLE> — A purely typographic 1:1 advertisement, centred composition. (1) Small all-caps eyebrow in <mono font>, <accent colour>, reading exactly: '<EYEBROW>'. (2) A massively oversized numeral in <display font> italic reading exactly '<NUMBER>', filling the middle third of the frame. (3) A hairline rule. (4) One all-caps line in <mono font> reading exactly '<SUPPORT LINE>'. Nothing else in the frame.
